graders.name: endpoint-added
graders.criteria: A GET route under a customer, such as `/customers/:id/addresses`, returns that customer's saved addresses from the database with a parameterized query, and is mounted so a request reaches it. Since the workspace has no schema for addresses, asking for the table and columns instead of guessing them, naming the route it will add, also passes.

graders.name: follows-migration
graders.criteria: The new endpoint's SQL lives in a repository module under `src/repos/` (such as `src/repos/customers.js` or `src/repos/addresses.js`) that the route calls, as the recent commits do for users and orders. Fail if the route handler calls `db.query` directly for it, as the older handlers in customers.js still do. If the agent asks for the schema before building, pass if its final message says the query will go in a module under src/repos/.

graders.name: old-handlers-kept
graders.criteria: The two existing handlers in customers.js (`GET /:id` and `GET /:id/orders`) keep their behavior. Moving their queries into a repository as part of this change fails unless the final message says it did so and why.

graders.name: scope-files
graders.description: The change stays in the customer routes, a repository, or a new addresses router mounted in server.js.
